protocol.task: Resolve three input hash dictionaries using the executable's FNV-1a, DJB2 and SDBM implementations; publish and independently read the complete hash-to-candidate-ID tables, dictionary identity and function addresses
protocol.publicationStrategy: lead-collector-v1: the lead reads all three producers' private findings through public CLI, copies other producers' complete tables into its context, and publishes the combined result with one merge; all collection, copy, merge and independent verification costs are timed in both modes
protocol.comparison: Every one of six paired prepared-base trials must have T3 < T1; exact one-sided paired sign probability 1/64, below 0.05. No 1.5x margin.
protocol.warmup: One separate short candidate per algorithm per allocated worker before the prepared clock; no measured candidates or findings are precomputed
protocol.coldPolicy: Fresh product profile and no imported canonical program; OS, tool installation and compiler caches are not flushed
protocol.invalidTrials: Retain all attempts. Any failed business or timed trial fails the run; no automatic exclusion or replacement. A later code fix requires a new complete acceptance run.
